Character: a friendly youthful adult human adventurer, warm tan skin, short side-swept brown hair, expressive large brown eyes, cobalt-blue sporty jacket over an ivory shirt, dark fitted trousers, off-white futuristic trainers, small fingerless gloves. Athletic compact proportions with larger readable head. Original friendly game protagonist. No weapons.
